signin.title: Sign in to continue your practice
signin.lede: Your attempts and progress are saved across every device you sign in to.

signup.title: Create your Tilawah account
signup.lede: Practise daily, track every attempt, and watch your recitation grow.

password.helper: Use 8+ characters with a mix of letters and numbers.
password.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

terms.label: I agree to the <tosLink>Terms of Service</tosLink> and <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>.
terms.error: Please accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to continue.

error.email_in_use: An account with this email already exists.
error.pending_deletion: This account is scheduled for deletion. Sign in to restore it.
error.google_link_required: This email is already registered. Sign in with your password to link Google.
error.google_unavailable: Google sign-in is currently unavailable. Please use your email and password.

brand.ayahTranslation: And recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.

library.title: Choose a surah to recite
library.description: Listen to a teacher's recitation, then record your own. We'll score your pronunciation against the reference.
library.searchPlaceholder: Search by surah name or number...

continue.emptyDescription: Pick any surah from the library below to record your first ayah.

suggested.blurbShort: Short surah · {count} ayahs · ~90 seconds. A great warm-up before longer practice.
suggested.blurbMedium: {count} ayahs · perfect for a focused practice session.
suggested.blurbLong: {count} ayahs · build endurance with regular reading.

error.title: Couldn't load the surah list
error.recovery: Check your connection and try again. If the problem persists, the service may be temporarily unavailable.

completion.title: {surahName} completed
completion.body: Beautifully done — pick another surah whenever you're ready.

page.tip: Tip: tap the mic to record, tap again to stop and submit.

recorder.headerErrorSubtitle: Your recording was too quiet or too short
recorder.captionRecording: Tap to stop and submit for scoring
recorder.tooShort: Recording was {seconds} s — too short to score

device.unsupported: Recording is not supported in this browser.
device.denied: Microphone access was denied. Please grant permission and try again.
device.failed: Could not start the recorder. Please try again.

liveStatus.idle: The recorder is ready. Press the microphone button to start recording.
liveStatus.recording: Recording in progress. Press the stop button to submit your recitation.
liveStatus.stuck: Analysis is taking longer than usual.
liveStatus.scoringErrorGeneric: Could not score that recording. Try recording again.

analysing.footer: This usually takes a few seconds

scoringError.defaultHint: Move closer to the microphone and try again

awaiting.headline: No score yet
awaiting.subhead: Try recording the ayah to receive your pronunciation feedback.

mastered.headline: Masterful recitation
mastered.subhead: Your recitation closely matches the teacher reference — move on whenever you're ready.

great.headline: Beautifully recited
great.subhead: Strong attempt — try once more to push past 90.

midway.headline: Some work to do — that's okay
midway.subhead: Several words came through differently than expected. Try listening to the teacher slowly and reciting along before recording again.

beginner.headline: Not quite there yet
beginner.subhead: Slow down with the teacher reference and focus on the sounds before retrying. Small, repeated passes work best.

characterMatch.label: Character match
characterMatch.description: Share of letters that matched the teacher's text

completeness.label: Completeness
completeness.description: How much of the ayah you recited

words.title: Word-by-word comparison
words.note: This is what the recognizer heard from your audio. Differences may come from the recognizer rather than your recitation — use it as a guide, not a verdict.
words.empty: Word-level alignment is not available for this attempt yet. Try recording again to surface a word-by-word breakdown.

listenBack.title: Listen back
listenBack.subtitle: Compare your recitation with the teacher's reference.
listenBack.youEmpty: The recording is no longer accessible. Try recording again to get a fresh comparison.
listenBack.audioFallback: Your browser does not support the audio element.

polling.title: Scoring your recitation…
polling.subtitleInitial: Hang tight — your detailed feedback will appear shortly.
polling.subtitleStuck: Scoring is taking longer than usual. You can wait — or cancel and try again.

history.title: History
history.description: Every attempt is saved so you can hear your progress over time.

signedOut.title: Sign in to track your practice
signedOut.body: Your attempts, best scores and continue-from progress sync across devices when you have an account.

empty.title: No attempts yet
empty.body: Your recent recitation scores will appear here once you start practicing.

history.filteredEmpty: No attempts for the selected surah yet.

preferences.title: Practice preferences
preferences.reminderHelper: Saved to your account — used once daily reminders are available.
preferences.saveError: Couldn't save your change. Please try again.
